tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap performed the Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml namespace rewrite and seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING/DEFERRED; the .cs files show the rewrite landed.

tools_problematic.problem: First build was extremely slow; the dev-agent burned turns 82-99 polling read_powershell/stop_powershell and ran out of turns before ever seeing the full error list or fixing it.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turns 82-99: repeated 120-600s read_powershell waits on shellIds 5,6,build1,8; log ends mid-build at turn 99.

tool_limitations.limitation: Inventory has no entry for Application.Suspending/Resuming or SuspendingEventHandler, so no inline TODO was injected at the suspend/resume call sites and the validator did not flag them.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add an 'adaptable' inventory entry routing to the #lifecycle anchor so Initialize injects a TODO at every Suspending/Resuming use site.

failed_apis.why_tried: Copied verbatim from the UWP sample's EventHandlerForDevice.cs / Scenario1 / Scenario4 to release the USB device on suspend and re-open on resume.
failed_apis.root_cause: WinUI 3 Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application removed the Suspending/Resuming events and the SuspendingEventHandler/SuspendingEventArgs types; desktop apps are not suspended/resumed like UWP.
failed_apis.fix: Remove the Suspending/Resuming subscriptions and SuspendingEventHandler/SuspendingEventArgs types; move any resource-release logic to Window.Closed / AppWindow.Closing (there is no suspend/resume on desktop).

failed_apis.api: x:DataType="local:Scenario" compiled binding in MainPage.xaml DataTemplate
failed_apis.why_tried: Copied from UWP MainPage.xaml ListBox.ItemTemplate using {x:Bind Title}.
failed_apis.root_cause: The dev-agent left the project in a split root namespace (MainPage.xaml.cs + SampleConfiguration.cs are 'SDKTemplate'; every Scenario*.cs is 'CustomUsbDeviceAccess'); x:Class/xmlns:local resolved to a namespace inconsistent with the model types, so the XAML compiler could not resolve local:Scenario (WMC0909/WMC1111) and cascaded to an internal compiler error (WMC9999).
failed_apis.fix: Keep C# namespace, x:Class, and xmlns:local="using:..." consistent across the whole project; x:Bind/x:DataType resolve types by CLR namespace.

special_apis.special_handling: This helper class ships in the entire UWP 'custom device access' sample family (USB/serial/HID/Bluetooth) and hardcodes App.Current.Suspending/Resuming wiring that has no WinUI 3 equivalent.

errors_encountered.error: CS: Application does not contain a definition for 'Suspending'/'Resuming' (Scenario1_ConnectDisconnect.xaml.cs, EventHandlerForDevice.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: WinUI 3 Application has no Suspending/Resuming events.
errors_encountered.fix: Delete the event subscriptions; relocate cleanup to Window.Closed.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' + WMC1111 x:DataType missing + WMC9999 internal compiler error in MainPage.xaml
errors_encountered.root_cause: Split/renamed root namespace made local:Scenario unresolvable for compiled bindings.
errors_encountered.fix: Unify the root namespace across .cs, x:Class and xmlns:local.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Repeatedly launched dotnet build, then spent 4-6 turns each polling with 120-600s read_powershell waits and stop_powershell restarts; never converged on a clean error list.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: net10.0 WinUI first build is slow and the raw build output is a wall of progress dots that hides the error lines; the agent kept re-running instead of capturing filtered output early.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — the trial ended (turn 99) with the build still running and errors unfixed.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Skill guidance to always redirect build output to a file and grep for 'error' (e.g. 'dotnet build ... 2>&1 > out.txt; Select-String error out.txt'), plus flagging the unsupported APIs up front via inventory TODOs so fewer build/fix cycles are needed.

missing_tooling.need: Inventory coverage for the UWP app-lifecycle Suspending/Resuming events so Initialize injects TODOs at the call sites.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The 11 compile errors that made the app non-functional (score 0).

env_issues.issue: First dotnet build of a net10.0 WinUI project takes minutes and emits noisy progress output.
env_issues.workaround: Redirect to a file and filter for error/warning lines.
